# Metatecno
> Metatecno is an independent manufacturer of chlor-alkali electrolyzer sealing products and fluoroplastic components made to reviewed drawings, samples and operating conditions.

## Official scope
- Chlor-alkali ion membrane electrolyzer gaskets and sealing products
- Compatible replacement gaskets reviewed by platform, sealing position, drawing and operating conditions
- Fluoroplastic sealing products and PTFE hose assemblies
- Electrolyzer cell repair and retrofit review

## Important pages
- [Product overview](https://www.metatecnocq.com/en/products/): Product and quotation routes
- [Chlor-alkali electrolyzer gaskets](https://www.metatecnocq.com/en/products/chlor-alkali-electrolyzer-gaskets/): Gasket scope and RFQ inputs
- [Technology and quality](https://www.metatecnocq.com/en/technology/): Published process and inspection overview
- [Request a technical quotation](https://www.metatecnocq.com/en/contact/): Drawing and operating-condition submission requirements
- [Privacy policy](https://www.metatecnocq.com/en/privacy-policy/): Inquiry and analytics data handling
- [Terms of service](https://www.metatecnocq.com/en/terms-of-service/): Website, quotation and compatibility terms

## Quotation facts
- A model number alone is not a complete quotation basis.
- Provide the drawing or sample photos, sealing position, material requirement, medium, temperature, pressure, quantity and operating conditions.
- Final material, dimensions, tolerances, inspection scope and suitability are controlled by the reviewed quotation, drawing or signed order.

## Compatibility notice
- Third-party model and brand names identify compatibility requirements only.
- Metatecno does not claim affiliation with, endorsement by or authorization from an original equipment manufacturer unless expressly documented.
